en: Desktop now supports Cloud sign-in and official hybrid relay for encrypted delivery when paired devices are offline. It also adds Sensitive Content Guard, clearer delivery progress, safer first-run v1 migration choices, and several Quick Panel and diagnostics improvements. All paired devices must use v2.
zh: 桌面端现支持登录 Cloud，并通过官方混合中转在配对设备离线时加密传送内容；同时新增敏感内容防护、更加清晰的传送进度、更安全的首次 v1 迁移选择，以及 Quick Panel 和诊断导出的改进。所有配对设备必须使用 v2。
